stemMd: A project has tasks A(2days), B(5days), C(3days) and D(4days). A starts at time0. B and C may start only after A finishes, and can run simultaneously. D may start only after both B and C finish. Ignore resource limits and use earliest starts. Select C’s finish time in column "C" and the project finish time in column "project".
instructionsMd: Select exactly one answer in each named column. Both selections must be correct. The project presents separate column lists rather than the official interface’s shared matrix or drop-down controls.
explanationMd: A finishes at2; B runs2–7 and C runs2–5. D starts at max(7,5)=7 and finishes at11. Adding all durations wrongly treats parallel tasks as serial.

distractorRationale.c-a: C need not wait for B.
distractorRationale.c-c: C cannot start before A finishes at2.
distractorRationale.project-a: D still requires four days after time7.
distractorRationale.project-c: D waits for B at7, not merely C at5.
distractorRationale.project-d: B and C can run in parallel.
